## Product facts

Free local mood, diary and running records; weekly mood reviews; search, favorites, app lock and local backup. iOS / iPadOS 16.0+ and paired watchOS 9.0+. The app supports 13 system languages; this website supports Simplified Chinese and English.

Free AI: 30 chat turns and 3 generations per month, plus a first-use device bonus of 20 turns and 2 generations. Plus: 600 turns and 60 generations per month, with equal monthly/annual plan benefits. Allowances reset each UTC calendar month and do not roll over. Diary drafts and summaries share generations. Final subscription prices are shown by Apple.

Records are primarily local, without app-provided cloud diary sync. AI is optional and requires explicit consent; necessary content is sent through the developer's HTTPS backend to DeepSeek. Optional mood, diary, memory and profile context is off by default. AI and purchase verification require internet access; authorized request content leaves the device. The upstream AI provider is not promised to have zero retention. This is not a medical or professional counseling service.

Development/support contact: 卫智超, 281916057@qq.com. App Store seller: Shanghai Qishan Cultural Communication Co., Ltd. Facts checked 2026-10-29.

Draft protection prompts before discarding edits; it is not persistent autosave. Backup import replaces local records and does not merge libraries. Read-only or isolated damaged data needs preservation before recovery. See the visible support and privacy pages for steps and retention boundaries.
